policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a pilot project report (実証結果報告書) accompanying a practical handbook on generative AI adoption in child and family policy domains. Conducted by ABeam Consulting on behalf of the Children and Families Agency. 14 local government entities participated with 45 use cases across document creation, data analysis, chatbot deployment, image recognition, and audio transcription. No binding obligations or penalties are established; findings are intended to inform voluntary adoption guidance.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around enabling practical adoption of generative AI in government (child and family services), with the stated purpose of advancing 'appropriate use' and sharing best practices via a handbook. Risk governance is subsidiary—security and data handling are addressed as operational concerns within the pilot, not as the central rationale. The driving logic is to demonstrate how AI can improve public service efficiency and quality, making innovation_enablement the dominant frame, with consumer/public safety secondary due to attention to data privacy and child-related sensitive information.

evidence_spans.quote: 生成AI利用時の論点・課題・効果等を整理し、ハンドブックとして公開することで、自治体や子育て関連事業者等における生成AIの適切な利用等を進めることを目的としている。
